# Font fixtures

Small fonts used by the font-format tests (`tests/test_feature_matrix.py`):

| File | Format | Faces | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ferro-collection.ttc` | TrueType collection | 0: "Ferro TTC First", 1: "Ferro TTC Second" | ASCII subsets of DejaVu Sans / DejaVu Serif |
| `ferro-cff.otf` | OpenType, CFF outlines | "Ferro CFF" | ASCII + ligature subset of Latin Modern Roman 10 |

They are regenerated by `make_fixtures.py`. The faces are subset and renamed:
they are modified versions of the original fonts, distributed under the
original licenses below.
